description_short: Restore mangrove forests along tidal coasts by re-establishing water exchange so mangroves can regenerate, or by planting where local conditions support establishment.
description_technical: Planting and ecological mangrove restoration share the tidal_coastal suitability family. Tidal inundation, intertidal elevation, salinity, sediment supply and wave exposure govern the footprint. Natural recruitment also depends on propagules reaching the site. Farming systems describe the surrounding landscape. The definition covers both on-site benefits and protection of land behind the stand. Project-specific inputs are required for the establishment window used in project risk screening, the time to a stated benefit, and the recurrent cost class. Leave these unset until site, intervention and outcome are specified and supported. T6E reports contextual cost evidence. Carbon credit eligibility depends on the project meeting its chosen standard.
